text.en:
Council for the Welfare of Children. - The Council for the
Welfare of Children shall continue to function and exercise the same powers pursuant
to the provisions of PD 603 and E0 233 (s. 1986). It shall be composed of the same
agencies and organizations as identified in EO 233 (s. 1986), with the Secretary of
Social Welfare and Development as the Chairperson. It shall be attached to the
Department of Social Welfare and Development.

Repealing Clause. - All executive orders, rules and regulations
and other parts thereof which are inconsistent with this Order are hereby revoked,
amended or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. - This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this gl
Two Thousand and Nine.
day of June _, in the year of our Lord,
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
